summary: Fixed XPath injection in CWE643_Xpath_Injection__getParameter_Servlet_51b.java by escaping the untrusted username and password values with StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml before interpolating them into the XPath query string. The commons-lang StringEscapeUtils class is already imported. Legitimate login lookups continue to work, but XPath metacharacters in the input are neutralized so they can no longer alter the query structure.
